payload.title: Clustering
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook applies clustering algorithms to oceanographic data to identify watermasses based on multiple traits. It uses Scikit Learn's clustering tools to analyze tracer data from the C-iTRACE dataset, focusing on both surface and sectional data. The notebook demonstrates the use of various clustering techniques, including Mean Shift and TSNE, to visualize and interpret the spatial distribution of watermasses. The outputs include clustered data visualizations in both positional and cluster space.
goals: Apply clustering algorithms to oceanographic data.
Identify and label watermasses based on physical and chemical characteristics.
Visualize clustering results in both positional and cluster space.
